audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and first item were given to Quinn and 4-5 and 6 to Skill, while whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Fiora winning those stages.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Skill, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Quinn, and the mirror slice already set win[1..5]=Fiora with win[6] staying Quinn.
audit.corrected: win[1..5] and phases[1..5].side set to Fiora with inverse ratings; the 2-item row stays Quinn and its rating rises.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1], [2] and [5] why-strings were generic and sold Quinn's spikes on Fiora's rows.
audit.why: Her spikes are Lunge plus Riposte at 2-3 and the Trinity timing at first item.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten to the real spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: early claimed 'a blinded Fiora can't proc vitals or her passive'.
audit.why: A blind hinders basic attacks, so it does stop her vital autos — but Lunge is an ability that applies on-hit effects, so a blinded Fiora still hits a vital with Lunge. Overstating the blind is what gets a Quinn killed after she spends it. Riposte parries ALL incoming damage for its window on a 24s rank-1 cooldown, which is the real reason not to commit into it.
audit.corrected: early, wants.you[0], report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d rewritten.

audit.why: Riposte 24/22/20/18/16, Lunge 13 down to 6, Grand Challenge 110/90/70.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: Vault resets the spacing whenever he closes. Only take the trade when Fiora's Riposte is down.
edits.after: Lunge and Riposte come online — she baits your blind and punishes the cast you commit.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Fiora must walk into your range.
edits.after: With her kit up she parries your commit and procs vitals faster than your blind cycles back.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riposte's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Trinity spike out-DPSes you in any extended trade and wins the side-lane 1v1 outright.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours to contest — your range and Harrier resets out-poke her before she has Q to close. But the second she gets her Q dash and W parry online at 2-3, this flips. Save Blinding Assault for AFTER she commits her Q in: a blinded Fiora can't proc vitals or her passive, and her autos miss. The trap is throwing Q early so she walks up free and parries your Vault for a stun.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours to contest — your range and Harrier resets out-poke her before she has Lunge to close. But the second Lunge and Riposte are online at 2-3, this flips. Save Blinding Assault for AFTER she commits Lunge: blinded, her vital autos whiff, though Lunge itself still hits a vital because it applies on-hit. The trap is throwing Q early so she walks up free.

edits.before: Land Blinding Assault (Q) the instant she Q-dashes in so her vital autos and passive proc whiff
edits.after: Blind her after Lunge lands — her vital autos whiff, but Lunge itself still applies on-hit

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries autos + stuns. Blind around it. When it is down — Vault-blind + R her.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and parries all damage — hold Vault and your blind until it is spent.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries autos + stuns. Blind around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riposte: 24s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — it parries all damage for the window, so never commit into it. - Lunge: 13s at rank 1 and it applies on-hit. - Grand Challenge: 110s of true damage plus a heal, so anti-heal early.

edits.before: Parries autos + stuns. Blind around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 24s at rank 1 — it parries all damage, so bait it out before you commit anything.

notes: Riposte stuns only if it blocks an immobilizing effect. Whether Vault's brief leap-off interrupt counts as immobilizing for that check is not in Riot's text and I could not verify it, so the existing claims in wants.foe[0] and spikes[1].text ('parry your Vault for the stun') were left untouched rather than repeated or removed — flagged as unverified. Fiora's Grand Challenge is true damage, so the Plated Steelcaps line in report[8].t is worth less here than the anti-heal it already recommends.
